description: Guides finding, mapping, synthesizing, and citing the literature with integrity — critical synthesis, fair engagement with rival work, paraphrase and quotation discipline, and rights and plagiarism checks. Use when a field of literature must be mapped, iteratively searched, and organized into a topic-based critical synthesis; when prior work must be engaged, criticized, or reconciled fairly by reading a rival's strongest meaning first; when sources must be paraphrased and cited rather than copied, with quotation reserved for when exact wording is the object of attention; or when legal-rights and academic-ethics standards (copyright, plagiarism) apply to reused material. Routes findings on evidence mapping, synthesis structure, paraphrase integrity, quotation discipline, rights checks, and fair engagement with rival work.
